units: <cite ref="Shabbat 149b">Sabb. 149ᵇ</cite> sq. (play on <he>מ̇ד̇ה̇ב̇ה</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 14:4">Is. XIV, 4</cite>) the nation that said <he>מְ֗ד̇וד̇</he>, <he>וה̇ב̇א</he> measure (the area of thy land) and bring (tribute); <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 15:9">Lev. R. s. 15</cite>, end (Ar.: <he>מוֹד והָבָה</he> measure and give).

<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 5:4">Erub. V, 4</cite> <he>אין מוֹדְדִין וכ׳</he> Sabbath distances must be measured only with a rope of &c. Ib. 5 <he>אין מודדין אלא מן המומחה</he> the measuring must be done only by the best experts.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 1:1:4">Y. Succ. I, 51ᵈ</cite> <he>אם יָמוֹד מן וכ׳</he> if he measures from &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 5:9">Maas. Sh. V, 9</cite> <he>עשור שאני עתיד לָמוֹֹד</he> one tenth (as tithe) which I shall measure off (when I come home); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 1:7">Sot. I, 7</cite> <he>במדה שאדם מוֹדֵד בה מוֹדְדִין לו</he> the measure with which man measures will be measured out to him, i.e. as man deals, he will be dealt with, v. <cite ref="A01758"><he>אַכְרַעְתָּא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 3:1">Tosef. ib. III, 1</cite> <he>מ׳ בסאה</he> he measured by the S’ah (committed great wrong).
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 9:5">Ber. IX, 5</cite>, v. next w.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 30b:5">Ib. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>לעולם יָמוֹד אדם וכ׳</he> man must always measure himself (examine the disposition of his mind; cmp. <cite ref="A01984"><he>אָמַד</he></cite>), if he feels that he can direct his mind, let him pray, if not &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 7:1">B. Bath. VII, 1</cite> <he>אינן נִמְדָּדִין עמה</he> are not included in the measure.
<cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 7:1">Arakh. VII, 1</cite> <he>נִמְדָּדִים עמה</he> are included &c.; a. fr.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 3">Gen. R. s. 3</cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 24">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXIV</cite>, a. e. <he>מְמַדֵּד</he>, v. <cite ref="M03039"><he>מָתַח</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:11">Cant. R. to VIII, 11</cite> <he>ממדדין</he>, v. <cite ref="D00131"><he>דָּדָה</he></cite>.]
